description:
Record a corporate spin-off event for Microsoft (MSFT) in the JStock portfolio. 

Scenario: Microsoft has spun off a division into NVIDIA (NVDA). You currently hold 50 shares of MSFT purchased for a total of $18,725.00 ($374.50/share). 

The spin-off terms are:
1. Shareholders receive 0.1 shares of NVDA for every 1 share of MSFT held.
2. 90% of the original MSFT cost basis stays with MSFT.
3. 10% of the original MSFT cost basis is allocated to the new NVDA shares.

Your goal is to:
1. Calculate the new cost basis for your MSFT position and the new NVDA position.
2. Edit the existing MSFT transaction in 'My Portfolio' to reflect the reduced (90%) cost basis. Add a comment 'Spinoff Adjustment'.
3. Add a NEW buy transaction for the NVDA shares received (0.1 ratio) with the allocated (10%) cost basis. Use today's date and comment 'Received from MSFT Spinoff'.

Do NOT modify the existing 25 shares of NVDA you already own.
